property_summary: For any caller address, the return value of approvedToLog must be true if and only if it was previously set to true via setApprovedLogger.
For any caller address, the return value of approvedToLog(caller) must be consistent with the caller being set as approved via setApprovedLogger.
For any caller, approvedToLog(caller) must return true if the caller was previously set as an approved logger via setApprovedLogger.
For any address, if it has never been added as an approved logger, then approvedToLog returns false.
After setting an address as an approved logger, the return value of approvedToLog on that address is true.
For any address and boolean status, after an onlyOwner call to setApprovedLogger, the approvedLoggers mapping at the caller address equals the status parameter.
After calling setApprovedLogger for any address, the approvedLoggers mapping value for that address is set to the new status.
For any address, after calling setApprovedLogger with that address and any status, the approvedLoggers mapping returns true if the status was true and the caller was the owner, else false.
The approvedLoggers mapping for any address is unchanged after calling approvedToLog.
After calling setApprovedLogger with any address and true, approvedToLog on that address returns true when called by the owner.
Calling setApprovedLogger as owner updates the approvedLoggers mapping for the given address.
For any caller that is approved, the log functions return true.
For any call to a log function, if the caller is approved, the function returns true.
For any approved caller, logCreated returns true when called; for a non-approved caller, it returns false.
For any caller, the return value of `logCreated` is equal to `approvedToLog(caller)`.
For any caller, logCreated returns true exactly when approvedToLog(caller) is true.
A call to logCreated returns true if and only if the caller is approved to log.
logRedemptionRequested should return true when called by an approved logger, and false otherwise.
The return value of logRedemptionRequested is the same as the caller's approval status when called by the owner.
logRedemptionRequested should return true when called by an approved logger, regardless of the caller's approval status for other functions.
When called by the contract owner, logRedemptionRequested returns the same boolean value as approvedToLog(owner), but for non-owner callers it returns the negation of approvedToLog(caller).
For any approved caller, logGotRedemptionSignature returns true after emitting GotRedemptionSignature.
For any approved caller, logGotRedemptionSignature must return true when called with arbitrary bytes32 arguments.
After a successful logGotRedemptionSignature call from an approved logger, the return value must be true.
If approvedToLog(caller) is true, then logGotRedemptionSignature must return true.
A call to logGotRedemptionSignature returns true if and only if the caller is approved and the call does not revert.
If an address is not approved as a logger, then calling any log function with that address returns false.
Calling the logSetupFailed function returns true if and only if the caller is an approved logger
After calling setApprovedLogger with an address and status true, that address is approved as a logger.
After calling setApprovedLogger to approve an address, calling logSetupFailed from that address returns true.
Calling logSetupFailed returns false if the caller is not an approved logger.
For any caller, the return value of logSetupFailed() is the negation of approvedToLog(caller).
Approved loggers always see 'true' returned from logSetupFailed, and unapproved loggers always see 'false'.
For any caller, `logFraudDuringSetup` either returns true and emits FraudDuringSetup, or returns false and does not emit.
For any caller, the return value of logFraudDuringSetup is true if and only if the caller is an approved logger.
After logFraudDuringSetup returns, the event FraudDuringSetup was emitted if and only if the return value is true.
For any caller, logFraudDuringSetup returns false if and only if the caller is not an approved logger.
Calling logFraudDuringSetup returns false if and only if approvedToLog(msg.sender) returns false.
A call to logFunded() from an approved logger returns true.
When caller is approved, logFunded() returns true.
logFunded returns true exactly when the caller is not approved.
When the caller is approved, logFunded() returns true.
The return value of logFunded() differs based on whether the caller is approved to log.
For any non-zero address, calling logFunded from an approved logger returns true.
For any address, calling logFunded from an approved logger returns true.
For any sender, calling logFunded() from an approved logger returns true and emits Funded event.
For any non-zero address that is approved as a logger, calling logFunded returns true.
For any address, if it is approved as a logger, then calling logFunded returns true.
For any address, if logFunded() is called by an approved logger, the function should return true and emit Funded; otherwise, it should return false without emitting.
After calling logFunded(), the contract's state remains unchanged (no public state variables are modified).
If logFunded() returns true, then the caller must be an approved logger.
The return value of logFunded() must be consistent with the caller's approval status before the call.
After a call to logFunded(), the Funded event is emitted if and only if the caller is an approved logger.
After calling logFunded, the return value must be true when the caller is approved to log.
The return value of logFunded must be equal to the caller's approval status (approvedToLog(caller)), for all callers.
Calling logFunded() returns the same boolean value as approvedToLog(msg.sender) at that moment.
After calling logFunded with an approved caller, the contract's approvedLoggers mapping for that caller remains unchanged.
Calling logFunded() returns true if and only if the caller was approved at the time of the call, and the caller's approval status remains unchanged.
A call to logCourtesyCalled from an approved logger always returns true.
A call to logCourtesyCalled from any address returns false if and only if the caller is not an approved logger.
A call to logCourtesyCalled from an approved logger returns false (the bug), while from the reference it returns true.
When logCourtesyCalled returns true, the caller is an approved logger.
The return value of logCourtesyCalled matches the negation of approvedToLog(msg.sender) for the caller.
After any call to logStartedLiquidation, calling c.approvedToLog(msg.sender) returns true and the return value of logStartedLiquidation equals the value of approvedToLog(msg.sender).
When the caller is an approved logger, logStartedLiquidation returns true.
For any caller, calling c.approvedToLog(caller) is always true if c.logStartedLiquidation(args) returns false.

After logStartedLiquidation is called by an approved logger, calling c.approvedToLog(msg.sender) still returns true, but the return value of logStartedLiquidation must be true if the logger is still approved.
If approvedToLog returns true for the caller, then logStartedLiquidation must return true.
For any caller, the return value of logStartedLiquidation is always true.
For any caller, the return value of logStartedLiquidation is the same as approvedToLog(caller) because the function returns true only if approvedToLog(msg.sender) is true.
For any caller, calling logLiquidated returns true if and only if the caller is not an approved logger.
An approved logger can successfully call logLiquidated, and the call returns true when the caller is not approved.
